subject: Post-call recap: Executive follow-up and next steps (Summit Health)
message_1_subject: Post-call recap: Executive follow-up and next steps (Summit Health)
message_1_body:
Hi Anita and Carlos,

Thanks again for taking time today — I appreciated the candid discussion with you and the Summit Health leadership team. Quick recap of the items we agreed on and the proposed next steps for executive alignment.

Key pain points:
- High latency and inconsistent inference costs for patient-facing summarization workflows
- Risk of PHI exposure with current multi-tenant endpoints and limited audit controls
- Procurement constraint around vendor onboarding for cloud-managed services

Business goals:
- Reduce per-transaction inference cost by ~40% while holding latency under 350ms p50
- Provide VPC/on-prem option for PHI-sensitive workloads and integrate with existing KMS
- Achieve an initial pilot across 3 clinical apps in Q2 with exec sign-off by end of Q2

Risk & escalation items:
- Security review: Summit needs SOC 2 + KMS integration docs for the pilot — we have a short list of artifacts
- Procurement: need an initial SOW and terms to kick off your legal review (Anita, you mentioned procurement prefers a 90-day review cadence)

Proposed next steps (owner / timeframe):
1) Send post-call deck + SOW draft — Marissa (today)
2) Internal security packet (SOC 2, KMS integration plan, audit log export sample) — Marissa & Aditya (by 2027-02-22)
3) Exec briefing: 30-min presentation for your CIO and VP of Clinical Ops — schedule for next week (Anita) / Confirm times (Marissa)
4) Procurement contact: connect with Summit procurement to start T&Cs — Anita to share contact (ASAP)

Attachments: Redwood_postcall_deck.pdf, SOW_Termsheet-draft.docx

If this captures everything, I’ll queue up the security artifacts and proposed SOW. Looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
message_2_subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive follow-up and next steps (Summit Health)
message_2_body:
Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this is helpful. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Procurement: I’m looping in our procurement lead, Maria Velasquez (maria.velasquez@summithealth.com) — she’ll own the SOW/PO path. Our target is to complete legal review within 60–75 days once we have the SOW.
- Security: SOC 2 plus KMS integration details will be required. We’ll run the artifacts through our security intake next week.
- Pilot scope: the three apps will be Clinical Summaries, Discharge Instructions, and Patient Messaging. We want a readout at the end of the pilot for exec sign-off.

Can you do a 30-minute exec briefing next Thursday (2027-02-25) at 10:00am PT? If so, please include a short slide on pilot KPIs and rollback/incident procedures.

Onwards — Anita
